description: Orders gains invoicing: orders/order.service.js now imports billing/invoice.js, which already imports orders/order.service.js (an import cycle). It also re-implements the existing isValidEmail validator.

expect.lesson: When a file adds an import of a sibling module, check whether that module already imports the file back; a new cycle is an architecture finding even if it happens to load today.
When added code formats, parses or validates a value, search for an existing helper doing the same job and report the duplicate by name.
